title: Introduce lightweight lint plugin registry and atomic build hooks to shrink CI surface
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Adds a lint plugin registry (language-aware adapters loaded on-demand), introduces an atomic build hook mechanism for staged release automation, and adds lightweight 'fast-dev' and 'full-ci' build profiles. Reduces CI matrix and prepares metadata for safer dependency rollouts.
description: Motivation: CI runtime and flakiness have been increasing with a wide lint/test matrix and global monolithic entrypoints. This PR extracts lint adapters into a small registry, introduces atomic build hooks to make release steps idempotent, and wires a dependency-provenance helper to support staged dependency upgrades. Approach: 1) Add tools/lint/plugins/registry.py and a minimal plugin API so language-specific linters load only for changed packages. 2) Introduce tools/build/profiles.yaml with 'fast-dev' and 'full-ci' profiles; CI workflows now select profile by changed path heuristics. 3) Replace heavy one-shot release script with .github/workflows/release-staging.yml that runs atomic hooks (preflight, package-stage, tag-and-bump) and records provenance. 4) Add scripts/dep_provenance.py to emit a small JSON manifest used by the release automation and dependency updater. 5) Update Makefile and dev container to expose the lightweight runner. Impact: expected median CI duration reduced for PRs touching single-language packages; lower noise from irrelevant linters; safer, restartable release flow with provenance artifacts for audits. Migration: ops: run tools/lint/plugins/register_local.py once in CI runner image migration window; repo: no manual changes required but maintainers can opt into per-package plugin configs under .lintrc. Rollback: remove registry flag and restore previous workflows if needed; all changes are guarded behind conditional selectors and tested in staging. Testing: unit tests for registry adapter loading and atomic hook idempotency added; integration smoke job 'release-staging/smoke' introduced that runs on a synthetic package. CI: initial run had one flaky smoke failure (reproducible locally) fixed by introducing a 250ms backoff in the hook runner; subsequent full CI passed. See commit list and CI checks below.

review_comments: Evan Greene (2025-08-13): Good direction. Please add metrics to show median CI time improvement and an ops migration plan. Also add a sanity check to ensure registry loading does not add >50ms to cold start.

Priya Nair (2025-08-14): Added CI timing exporter to tools/ci/matrix_selector.py and a short ops migration section in README.ci.md. Cold-start microbenchmark shows ~18ms median overhead for the registry. Replying inline with benchmark results.

Marta Valdez (2025-08-15): The release-staging workflow looks safer, but the hook runner should persist a lightweight lock file to avoid concurrent stages on the same package. Please add and re-run smoke tests.
Priya Nair (2025-08-16): Added lockfile support in c3d5f90 and extended smoke test; initial smoke failed intermittently, fixed by small backoff. Commented with repro and fix details.
Jun Park (2025-08-18): Verified path-aware selection prevents running Go linters on JS-only changes. Approving pending CI green.
Evan Greene (2025-08-19): Approved. Left one nit about a doc link which I fixed in a follow-up commit.

test_plan: Automated: unit tests + integration smoke on release-staging pipeline. Manual: ops run registries migration job in staging, then observe CI timing metrics for two weeks. Canary: enable fast-dev profile for a small set of repos before org-wide rollout.
